mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, weekday discretionary trips stay suppressed and RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT do not recover from their current depressed levels within the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A further weekly drop in TRANSIT below the current low forces immediate substitution away from city-center shopping, so RETAIL_REC falls within one to two weeks after each additional transit decline.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls > 3 points week-on-week from the current level
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 1-2 weeks after a further TRANSIT drop of more than 3 points from the current week.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM is nonnegative and RESIDENTIAL is high at the same time, routine errand traffic offsets some discretionary spending loss, producing a modest rebound in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM turns back to at least 0 while RESIDENTIAL stays at or above +7
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or declines for two weeks after GROCERY_PHARM returns to nonnegative and RESIDENTIAL remains at or above +7.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS and TRANSIT both fall again from already weak levels, it signals renewed containment or caution that will spill over into retail visits and push RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS and TRANSIT each fall below their current 4-week averages
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not underperform its last-4-week mean in the 28 days after both PARKS and TRANSIT move below their current four-week averages.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS keeps rising from its recent trough while other categories stay weak, outdoor leisure substitutes for indoor shopping and RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points from the current week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within two weeks after PARKS rises by at least 5 points from the current week.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous recovery in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT increases routine weekday circulation and should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks, because more commuters generate incidental retail visits.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean after two consecutive weeks of improvement in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: Under a stay-home regime, a higher RESIDENTIAL reading paired with weak WORKPLACES suppresses trip generation and keeps RETAIL_REC below the prior month’s average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC exceeds its last-4-week mean despite RESIDENTIAL staying above +7 and WORKPLACES staying below -20 for most of the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM remains near zero or negative while TRANSIT stays below -20, the city is still in a constrained mobility regime, and retail shopping will continue to contract over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -20 and GROCERY_PHARM does not recover above 0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves within 1-2 weeks even though TRANSIT remains below -20 and GROCERY_PHARM does not move above 0.
